timers.blariyo-collectionConfig:
# /etc/systemd/system/blariyo-collection.timer
[Unit]
Description=Blariyo collection at 04:30 and 15:30 Asia/Seoul

[Timer]
OnCalendar=*-*-* 04:30:00 Asia/Seoul
OnCalendar=*-*-* 15:30:00 Asia/Seoul
Persistent=false
AccuracySec=1s
RandomizedDelaySec=0
Unit=blariyo-collection.service

[Install]
WantedBy=timers.target
timers.blariyo-discord-reviewConfig:
# /etc/systemd/system/blariyo-discord-review.timer
[Unit]
Description=Blariyo Discord review maintenance every minute

[Timer]
OnBootSec=90s
OnUnitInactiveSec=60s
AccuracySec=5s
Unit=blariyo-discord-review.service

[Install]
WantedBy=timers.target
timers.blariyo-discord-review-scanConfig:
# /etc/systemd/system/blariyo-discord-review-scan.timer
[Unit]
Description=Blariyo Discord review 07:30 and 17:00 KST

[Timer]
OnCalendar=*-*-* 07:30:00 Asia/Seoul
OnCalendar=*-*-* 17:00:00 Asia/Seoul
Persistent=true
AccuracySec=1s
Unit=blariyo-discord-review-scan.service

[Install]
WantedBy=timers.target
